requirements.ask_text: What are the six digits of your account code?

source.text: M-1: the identity scheme shall be conducted in this order: first `konto_code`, then `geburtsdatum`, then `postleitzahl`. (Policy 4.2: `konto_code` digits, six (6) digits with leading zeros preserved; "What are the six digits of your account code?")

requirements.ask_text: What is your date of birth, as registered?

source.text: 4.2 `geburtsdatum` a date, numerals only read day-month-year (dmy); for `geburtsdatum`, "What is your date of birth, as registered?"

requirements.ask_text: What is your postcode, as registered?

source.text: 4.2 `postleitzahl` text, letters and digits, spacing removed. No format-hint facility is provided. for `postleitzahl`, "What is your postcode, as registered?"

identity.failed_instruction: Our service desk will verify you instead.

source.text: M-2: The global ceiling of unsuccessful answers is lowered to four (4), in place of three (3). The remaining-slot field returned by the identity facility continues to govern the count; the Operations Division shall make no private tally.
Telephone contact days are today or the next business day, exactly as clause 3.1 of the O&M Policy says. The contact hours stated in M-3 remain: 09:00 to 18:00 inclusive.
3.4 A wrong number closes HL-MISS/hl-wrong. The passing of the holder closes the call with HL-MISS/hl-deceased after the exact sentence: "Our condolences on your loss."

5.1 Business days are Monday through Saturday. Sunday alone is closed. No other closure day is observed during these operations. 5.3 "Next <weekday>" names that weekday in the following calendar week, even when spoken on that weekday itself. 5.4 A period named without month and year ("the 15th") resolves to the next occurrence, on or after today, of the named day.

7.1(a) 1-9 days past: the earlier of the ninth calendar day after the call and of the last business day of the current calendar month; 7.2(a) exactly one attempt, the full `outst` on the k-date; where the full amount has already been refused, the floor is named instead
7.1(b) 10-29 days past: the fifteenth (15th) day of the calendar month following the call, shifted to the next business day wherever needed; 7.2(a) exactly one attempt

M-4: For the late band (30-60 days past) the ultimate date shall be the twentieth (20th) day of the calendar month following the call, shifted to the next business day wherever needed. The band's two-attempt schedule in clause 7.2 is unchanged.

6.2 The floor field per category is: od -> `od_min`; term -> `tl_min`; equip -> `eq_min`; card -> `cl_min`; invoice -> `inv_min`. 8.1 The full amount is asked first; the debtor is never asked what it can pay. 8.2 An amount of floor to full, both included, is recordable; the floor offered once with the sentence "The remainder falls due again."

8.3 A date is recordable when today or later, a business day (5.1), and no later than the facility's k-date; a date on a closed day within the k-date moves to the next business day. 7.4 ... if none is given still, the k-date is proposed. 7.5 A date beyond the k-date is met by naming the k-date as the latest recordable date

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid this facility.
special_cases.say: Payments appear within two working days.

source.text: 10.1 "Already paid": the exact reply "Payments appear within two working days."; no record is taken for that facility, the note hl-cleared is set (11.1), and the remaining facilities continue.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never held the facility, or it was settled and closed.

source.text: 10.2 "Not my debt", "never held it", or "it was settled and closed": no argument, no record; the note hl-dispute is set for that facility and the remaining ones continue.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement, or loss of work.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: 10.3 Illness, bereavement, or loss of work: one short sentence of sympathy; no persuasion and no record for that facility; the note hl-distress is set; NO transfer is offered and the remaining facilities continue.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a payment schedule or lighter instalments.

source.text: 10.4 A schedule or lighter instalments: clause 8.4 forbids any; the call moves at once to the remediation desk, queue `hl-rework`, and closes HL-TR/hl-rework.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a person.

source.text: 10.5 A person: ask once whether this assistant can help; treatment 10.6 otherwise. On insistence, queue `hl-desk`, close HL-TR/hl-person.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses the call as a whole and does not want to continue talking.

source.text: 10.6 A refusal of the call as a whole: ask once whether one may continue; a second refusal sets hl-refuse on every remaining facility (11.1) and ends under 11.3.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam or doubts that the call is really from the bank.
special_cases.say: You may verify us on the number printed on your contract letter.

source.text: 2.4 A scam question is answered exactly: "You may verify us on the number printed on your contract letter." The call continues (q.v. 10.7, 10.8).

table.when: transfer to a desk; overrides every other rank
no payment recorded; reason is the note of the first non-cleared facility
holder not reached / third party / unclear holder

source.text: 11.3 Outcome rank: a transfer rank overrides every other; else any recorded payment gives HL-PAY; else, every facility noted hl-cleared gives HL-CLR; else HL-FULL with the note of the first non-cleared facility, in account-facility order. 11.4 The call is thanked and farewelled before exactly one close call.
11.1 ... one note is set per unrecorded facility among: hl-refuse, hl-distress, hl-dispute, hl-cleared, hl-R07. 11.2 On any transfer-class closure ... NO note is set, at any time.
1.3 This Policy governs up to five facilities per debtor; 6.1 ... at most five (5) entries; 6.3 Every facility ... is stated before any ask; 9.1 Every proposed payment is read back in one batch

source.text: 2.1 The first sentence shall be said verbatim ... 2.2 "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?" 2.3 forbidden words ... 2.4 robot/scam replies ... 6.4 Spoken categories ... 6.5 The reason for the call is introduced exactly ... 9.5 A written record is acknowledged exactly ... 10.9 ... exactly "Our service desk will advise that."

11.5 A failure of the writing facility is retried once; a second failure sets hl-R07 on that facility alone (11.1), the failure is stated, and the remaining facilities continue. 9.1 ... confirmed exactly: "May I record these payments?" 9.3 One record per facility

unresolved.text: Clause 7.1(a) does not say whether the ninth calendar day after the call is shifted when it falls on a Sunday; taken unadjusted.
The documents imply a first ask to settle today (7.3 'A first plain refusal to settle today') but dictate no wording; a minimal sentence was written.
10.3 requires 'one short sentence of sympathy' without dictating the words; a minimal sentence was written.
The tool API defines the amount property as `sum` but lists `amt` as required; the documents do not name the field.
Clause 7.1 defines bands only for 1-60 days past; facilities at 0 or more than 60 days past are not covered.
10.7 robot question has no known special-case name; handled only through phrases.robot_reply (the call continues).
No card last-digits field exists and the documents name the card category only as "store card".

unresolved.topic: already paid vs. paying this overdue amount
unresolved.text: 10.2 ends 'A payment of this very overdue amount is NOT what 10.1 covers', which seems to contradict 10.1 'Already paid'; the extraction keeps 10.1 for a customer saying the facility is already paid and 10.2 for not my debt / never held / settled and closed.
10.5 'ask once whether this assistant can help; treatment 10.6 otherwise' does not make clear when the 10.6 refusal treatment applies instead of the hl-desk transfer on insistence.
9.4 'A whole-batch refusal closes with no notes taken contrary to clause 11.2' is garbled; taken to mean notes per 11.1 (no transfer), but the note code for a refused read-back is not named.
11.5 'the failure is stated' dictates no wording.
7.2(b) does not say whether the first band-(c) attempt names the floor when the full amount was already refused; taken as no (the floor is the second attempt).
Mail S-72 is headed 'Wed 13 Oct 2026', but 13 Oct 2026 is a Tuesday; no value depends on it.
